occurrences.text: And now I exhort you to be of good cheer: for there shall be no loss of any man’s life among you, but of the ship.
For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
